78d750.title: G6 Hospitality wildcard surface discovery — www redirect-only
78d750.content:
Coverage for `https://*.g6hospitality.com/` found one conventional reachable wildcard host: `www.g6hospitality.com`.

- AIDAST exchanges `96e25a35-caef-4907-8ce9-d0657655812f` and `8bf1b399-ac0d-4dd1-8f79-5e6f21db458a`: `GET https://www.g6hospitality.com/` returned `301 Location: https://g6hospitality.com/`. Headers identify Cloudflare (`Server: cloudflare`), WordPress/WP Engine (`X-Powered-By: WP Engine`, `X-Redirect-By: WordPress`), HSTS, and `Permissions-Policy`.
- Agent-browser navigation confirmed the same redirect; the next document at `https://g6hospitality.com/` was `403 Blocked by approved Scope`. The destination is the bare apex and therefore outside this child task's `*.g6hospitality.com` wildcard scope. It was not crawled.
- `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, and `wp-sitemap.xml` on `www` over HTTP/HTTPS returned Cloudflare `403`, with no sitemap, routes, forms, API parameters, JavaScript, GraphQL, or OpenAPI evidence. See journal IDs `1ba722f3-6402-49c3-a156-1bf970a70b2d`, `11c1d468-8194-4c7b-b0a5-dc02b9d1c1fc`, `f66488bc-a7bd-4866-ba30-28cabf7f40f8`, `722ca9d7-9ff4-4e96-af97-d6e477f4a64b`, `7404d34b-930e-4fd1-a15c-83e79145f6e8`.
- Bounded Katana (`JS`, XHR, endpoint extraction, known robots/sitemap files) was attempted on `https://www.g6hospitality.com/` restricted to the wildcard. It encountered only the root redirect and its follow to the scope-blocked apex; no in-wildcard routes were emitted.

Gap: no other wildcard subdomains were disclosed by target content, published artifacts, or pre-existing AIDAST capture; an attempted external certificate-transparency lookup was rejected by the Scope proxy and was not used.

d7413a.title: oyorooms.io wildcard surface discovery blocked by upstream DNS
d7413a.content:
Read-only discovery against in-scope wildcard `*.oyorooms.io` found no reachable application surface.

Evidence:
- `httpx` seeded `www`, `api`, `web`, `auth`, `login`, `partner`, `admin`, `staging`, and `dev` over both HTTP and HTTPS through `$HTTP_PROXY` (`127.0.0.1:48080`). 8985d5.title: Motel6 wildcard surface discovery — blocked/reachability evidence
8985d5.content:
Assigned scope: `https://*.motel6.com/` only. Read-only discovery performed with `HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:48080`.

DNS-confirmed in-scope hosts:
- `www.motel6.com` → `www.motel6.com.edgekey.net` / `e318420.a.akamaiedge.net` (A `23.202.97.90`, `23.202.97.83`).
- `book.motel6.com` → `tls-a.g6hospitality.edgekey.net` / `e10385.a.akamaiedge.net` (A `104.76.68.241`).
- `api.motel6.com` → `d-7vwgq5g8cd.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com` (A values returned, including `54.158.89.43`, `54.227.68.250`; later resolver output differed). CNAME target was not accessed because it is outside scope.
- `mobile.motel6.com` → A `172.21.224.150`; IP was not accessed directly.

Candidate labels `m`, `reservations`, `careers`, `help`, and `partners` had no DNS response in the checked resolver output.

Discovery results:
- `www`: proxied `http://www.motel6.com/`, `https://www.motel6.com/`, `/robots.txt`, and `/sitemap.xml` all produced no response; curl timed out at 25 seconds; Katana root request error was `context deadline exceeded`; `agent-browser open https://www.motel6.com/` failed `CDP command timed out: Page.navigate`.
- Bounded Katana, configured with JS crawl, XHR extraction, forms, and known files (`robots.txt`/`sitemap.xml`), requested roots and robots/sitemaps for `book` and `api`. `book` root got proxy `502 Bad Gateway` body `connection closed`; `api` root got proxy `502 Bad Gateway` body `Certificate verify failed: hostname mismatch`. No origin content, routes, forms, XHR, JavaScript, redirects, query/body parameter names, GraphQL evidence, or OpenAPI/Swagger evidence were obtained.
- `mobile` Katana root request timed out (`context deadline exceeded`).
- HTTP/HTTPS `httpx` pass submitted both schemes for all DNS-confirmed hosts. Only HTTPS responses were emitted: `book` and `api` were `502`, served by `mitmproxy 12.2.3`; `www` and `mobile` produced no result before request deadlines.

Artifacts retained in `/workspace/motel6-recon/`: `dns-evidence.txt`, `httpx-seeds.txt`, `root-headers.txt`, `httpx-http-https.jsonl`, `katana-www.jsonl`, `katana-www-errors.log`, `katana-services.jsonl`, and `katana-services-errors.log`.

Coverage conclusion: this is an unresolved discovery gap caused by proxied upstream failures/timeouts, not evidence that the hosts lack routes.

d69417.title: Weddingz wildcard surface discovery
d69417.content:
Read-only discovery on approved `*.weddingz.in` found five evidence-backed hosts:

- `www.weddingz.in`: HTTP 302 → `http://weddingz.in/`; HTTPS 302 → `https://weddingz.in/` (apex was outside the wildcard target and not followed).
- `m.weddingz.in`: HTTP 301 → HTTPS, then HTTPS 301 → apex; nevertheless `robots.txt` (200) lists sitemap references and image/rate disallow rules; `sitemap.xml` (200, 30 KB) indexes home plus city listing sitemap files, all canonical `weddingz.in` URLs, not followed.
- `api.weddingz.in`: HTTP 301 → HTTPS; HTTPS `/` 200 plain text `Weddingz Content Service - Server is up!`; `robots.txt`/`sitemap.xml` 404 JSON. `/openapi.json` and `/swagger.json` are 200 but 108-byte empty HTML, not API specs.
- `media.weddingz.in`: HTTP and HTTPS `/`, `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml` return 403 (Amazon CloudFront/S3).
- `blog-cms.weddingz.in`: HTTP/HTTPS public 200 WordPress blog (Apache 2.4.55/PHP 7.3.11, MySQL; `weddingz-blog-theme-master`, `wp-security-hardening` plugin). Katana crawl output preserved under `/workspace/aidast-capture/weddingz/blog-katana.jsonl` (27 fetched pages), including public posts and archive routes. Public UI exposes GET search `/?s=<term>`; comment submission POST `/wp-comments-post.php` body keys: `comment,author,email,url,wp-comment-cookies-consent,submit,comment_post_ID,comment_parent`. It advertises `/feed/`, `/comments/feed/`, `/xmlrpc.php?rsd`, `/wp-login.php`, `/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php`, and `/wp-admin/post-new.php?post_type=event`; direct feed/XML-RPC requests returned 403, `wp-json/` 403, `wp-sitemap.xml` 404. Browser navigation to `/wp-login.php` failed due a same-host HTTP/HTTPS redirect loop (HTTPS 302 Location HTTP identical path); no credential actions.

No observed GraphQL or valid OpenAPI/Swagger body; no protocol skills used and no operations parsed. Candidate aliases `app, admin, partner, vendors, careers, blog, static, cdn, images.weddingz.in` returned proxy 502 during initial bounded host verification, so these remain reachability gaps rather than absent surface.

ed80cb.title: Patron OYO Rooms surface map (ca189c0a)
ed80cb.content:
Exact approved host: `https://patron.oyorooms.com/`

**Reachability and routes**
- `http://patron.oyorooms.com/` and `https://patron.oyorooms.com/` resolve to HTTPS then loop with `302` `Location: /kr/...` when no usable locale is present. This is a discovery gap, not a negative result.
- `GET /robots.txt` 200 permits crawling and names `GET /sitemap.xml`.
- `GET /sitemap.xml` 200 lists regional public landing pages: `/in`, `/id`, `/my`, `/sa`, `/ae`, `/br`, `/mx`, `/ph`, `/us`, and `/in/tnc`.
- Stable pages observed 200: all sitemap regional pages except `/us`, which 301s to `/us/` then participates in locale redirection in this session; `/in/tnc` 200.
- React route literals found in bundle: locale-relative `/*`, `/login`, `/tnc`, `/tnc/*` (so `/in/login` was opened read-only and returned the app shell 200).

**Same-host APIs disclosed by `main.32264a98.js` (not invoked)**
- `GET /partnerpage/api/get_page_data` with `country`, `locale`.
- `GET /partnerpage/api/search_location` with `query`, `region`, optional `filter_ids`.
- `GET /partnerpage/api/earning_potential` with `country_id`, `city_id`.
- `PUT /partnerpage/api/submit_info` JSON array body; client assigns `source=OAM` and `sub_source` of `OTHER` or `OWNER`.
- `POST /partnerpage/api/otp_service/sign_up`; `POST /partnerpage/api/auth_service/sign_in`; `POST /partnerpage/api/auth_service/sign_in_otp`.
- `POST /partnerpage/api/otp_service/generate_otp` uses `{phone,country_code}`; `POST /partnerpage/api/otp_service/generate_login_otp` uses `{phone,country_code,country_iso_code}`.
- Authenticated/onboarding bundle routes: `GET v1/oam/list_properties?page=0&page_size=100`, `GET v1/oam/property_funnel/{id}`, `GET v1/oam/basic_property_info/{id}`, `GET v1/oam/city_country_suggestion` (`lat`,`lng`,`fetch_entity_ids`), `POST v1/oam/basic_property_info`, `POST v1/oam/trigger_scrape_kafka`, `GET v1/oam/atlas_scrapped_property` (`id`), `POST v1/oam/upload?type=oam&file_name_prefix=property`, and `v1/oam/profiles/sign_out`. The exact base/origin and helper HTTP verb for some `v1/oam` paths were inferred from client helper call structure; no unauthenticated requests were sent.
- Client-side property/onboarding fields: `phone`, `phone_number`, `email`, `password`, `full_name`, `hotel_name`, `property_name`, `room_count`, `address`, `city_id`, `country`, `lat`, `lng`, `property_unique_id`, `source`, `supply_model_type`; image upload flow declared.

**UI / technology**
- Browser snapshot for `/in` exposes a telephone textbox and Submit plus Join OYO control. Server data and bundle show signup/login/password/OTP and protected property-management flows. No fields were entered and no submission/registration occurred (root-only authorization).
- React server-rendered shell with webpack assets: `/partnerpage/static/js/main.32264a98.js`, chunks `2.7ee550cc`, `3.11ed1575`, `polyfills.c50d8994`; stylesheet `/partnerpage/static/css/main.08514ef6.css`; HSTS and CSP. `window.__SERVER_DATA__` says `hms_self_onboarding_enabled=true`.
- Browser content is rendered inside an allowed external `partners.oyorooms.com/he` frame due page configuration. It was not mapped under this exact-host assignment. External analytics/fonts/CDN requests were also not considered in-scope.
- No GraphQL endpoint/traffic and no OpenAPI/Swagger document/reference found.

**Evidence**
- Raw `httpx`, robots/sitemap, Katana JSONL/responses, downloaded HTML/JS and derived context are preserved under `/workspace/aidast-capture/patron-oyorooms-ca189c0a/`.
- Live journal body reviewed: capture ID `268d87d2-38da-4f55-9df7-108bba95def7` (`GET /in`, 200).

5ee636.title: Traum Ferienwohnungen surface discovery
5ee636.content:
Read-only mapping completed for `https://*.traum-ferienwohnungen.de/` through the configured proxy. Evidence artifacts: `/workspace/traum-surface/reachability.txt`, `robots-sitemap-headers.txt`, `katana.txt` (76,186 lines / 4,197 unique URLs before stopping sitemap-driven expansion), `subdomain-reachability.txt`, `route-families.txt`, and targeted landing-subdomain Katana outputs.

Canonical public application: `https://www.traum-ferienwohnungen.de/` (200; Next.js/React/Node/Webpack, HSTS/HTTP3); bare apex returned 403. `robots.txt` advertises 18 sitemap URLs for listing/region/topic/property/offer content. UI exposes location/date/guest search widgets, property listing/detail routes, offers, holiday ideas, magazine, landlord marketing, newsletter email field, and authenticated traveler/landlord areas. Login path redirects to `accounts.traum-ferienwohnungen.de/login` and has customer ID/email + password fields, password recovery, and owner/vacationer registration links; no registration or login attempted.

Crawl/bundle extraction identifies public API route families under `/api/search/v1|v2`, `/api/listings/v1`, `/api/expose/v1`, `/api/tracking/v1|v2`, `/api/users/v1`, `/api/v1/{card-sections,data-events,head,landlord-area,maps,pages,wishlist}`, `/api/v2/pages/home`, plus `/guest-website-frontend/session` and `/guest-website-frontend/api/v1/session/{session-id}/ab-config`. Runtime browser traffic confirmed a 200 AB-config JSON endpoint and observed user-details request with `additionalDetails=true`; do not retain transient session ids. No GraphQL, OpenAPI, or Swagger evidence observed.

Discovered in-scope hosts: accounts, auth, hilfe, images, img2, media, static2, swiftcover, traum-premium-partnerschaft, unternehmen, akademie, plaza, www, apex. HTTPS reachability: Swiftcover and Premium Partnership 200 (Landingi/jQuery); image CDNs 200; media/static2 403 at root; auth 404 root; Hilfe 301 to `www/.../hilfe/` (WordPress observed); several subdomains produced proxy 502 on HTTP. Targeted crawl found Swiftcover paths `/account/`, `/thanks`, `/upload`, `/button/{id}` and Premium Partnership `/account/`, `/nachtrag`.

Gaps: wildcard scope cannot be exhaustively enumerated without an authorized hostname source; `akademie`, `unternehmen`, and `plaza` root HTTP probes were proxy 502; content sitemaps were catalogued but not fully crawled due large listing corpus. Crawler URL extraction includes a limited amount of external-link noise; only `*.traum-ferienwohnungen.de` hosts are surface evidence.

ac29ea.title: Belvilla surface discovery (www + partner)
ac29ea.content:
## Scope and raw evidence
- Raw crawl outputs: `/workspace/belvilla-recon/katana.txt` (82,788 lines; unrestricted run had duplicate/cross-domain URL noise), `/workspace/belvilla-recon/katana-scoped.txt` (50,365 lines; still duplicate-heavy), extracted summary `/workspace/belvilla-recon/inventory-extract.txt`, host checks `/workspace/belvilla-recon/scheme-host-results.txt`.
- Useful capture IDs: `b15a339a-977e-4727-a972-a5900bc03f9d` main `https://www.belvilla.com/` (200); `b2c216d7-b3ab-455a-9321-e2876483bf22` robots; `9650b46b-7d3c-44ea-a3eb-42adf85ad62b` stale cross-brand `/sitemap.xml`; `ccacb03d-f90f-49c3-8ee2-05f51e853c5a` GET `/api/pwa/getTemperature?units=auto&lat=`; `7355f1c3-de27-47a1-93a2-627ce26e318f` partner owner-flow JS.

## Hosts
- `https://www.belvilla.com/`: 200, React; observed technologies: HSTS, Cookiebot, Google Tag Manager, Adobe Fonts/Typekit. `http://www.belvilla.com/` reached same application in httpx results (200 after follow behavior).
- `https://partner.belvilla.com/`: 307 to `/en`; owner acquisition site, Next.js, HSTS/HTTP3.
- `https://belvilla.com/`: 403. `api`, `app`, `booking`, `m` over HTTP returned proxy/live 502; their HTTPS probes supplied no response. `nl/de/en/fr` candidate HTTPS names supplied no response. Treat these as reachability gaps, not negative endpoint evidence.

## www.belvilla.com surface
- Public UI: location search (`Search by city, home, or neighborhood`), country/region/listing links, newsletter `Email address`, account modal at `/?modal=socialLogin&retUrl=%2F`, login fields `Enter Email` and `Minimum 8 character password or booking id`, forgot-password and Google SSO links. No submission performed.
- Route families: `/search/` with `filters[country_id]`, `filters[location_id]`, `filters[city_id]`, `filters[amenities]`, `filters[number_of_pets][min]`, `filters[property_type]`, `filters[reduced_mobilities]`, `filters[nearby_location_ids]`, plus `searchType`, `country_id`, `location`, `guests`, `rooms`, `rooms_config`, `checkin`, `checkout`, `flexibleDaysCount`, `isLatLngSearch`, `showMap`, `selected_rcid`, `page`; property detail paths `/{country-code}/{numeric-id}/`; localized SEO destination/listing paths.
- API routes observed/extracted: GET `/api/pwa/getTemperature` (`units`, `lat`); `/api/pwa/QnASearch`; `/api/pwa/hotelrating/`; `/api/pwa/shortlists`; `/api/pwa/shortlists/count`. Crawl observed JSON error/status behavior for calls without expected client state/arguments; do not treat as testing.
- Static/app routes: `/booking/`, `/accountdetails/`, `/accountdetails/oyomoney/`, `/faq/`, `/terms/`, `/privacy-policy/`, `/service/privacy/`, `/service/disclaimer/`, `/service/about-belvilla/`, `/certainty/`, `/travel-agencies/`, `/holiday-cottage-parks/`, `/belvilla-exclusive/`, `/rent-my-holiday-home/`.
- robots capture lists disallowed route families `/kws`, `/content/`, `/booking_v3/`, `/checkout`, `/aj_windows/travelagencies/`, `/search2`, `/search-old`, `/property/*`, country-prefixes, `/booking/`; it names sitemaps `/blog/sitemap_index.xml`, `/sitemap/country-sitemap.xml`, and `/static/feeds/google_sitemaps/v2/bvdir_en_wwwcom.xml`. Country and blog sitemaps were 200. `/sitemap.xml` is an old OYO sitemap response, and is not a Belvilla inventory.

## partner.belvilla.com surface
- Public owner lead form: `Name`, `Email address`, `Mobile number`, property location, bedroom/property-type inputs, `Calculate revenue`; also `Sign in` and locale routes `/en`, `/pl`, `/de`, `/fr`, `/nl`, `/es`, `/it` from alternate headers. No submission.
- JS discloses but this recon did not call: POST `/api/lead/save` (sets request `X-Host-Domain`), GET `/api/location/geocode?address=`, GET `/api/location/reverse-geocode?lat=&lng=`, and GET `/api/location/autocomplete?input=`. Also uses Google Places client library.
- The UI Sign in control navigates to `accounts.traum-ferienwohnungen.de/login`; browser was left/reset to Belvilla after viewing only that login gate. No credentials or authentication interaction.

## Protocol/schema
- No GraphQL requests/pages/client references observed.
- `/swagger.json` and `/api-docs` each returned 200 HTML-sized app fallback (108 bytes), and `/.well-known/openapi.json` was 404; no OpenAPI document was observed or parsed.

8f39d9.title: OyoRooms.com wildcard surface discovery
8f39d9.content:
Read-only discovery on `https://*.oyorooms.com/` identified reachable `www`, `bff`, `business`, `frames`, `partners`, `partner`, and `web` subdomains. Primary surface and evidence:

- `www.oyorooms.com`: React consumer booking site. HTTP redirects/upgrades to HTTPS. Routes include localized listing/detail (`/{country}/{hotel_id}/`, `/{country}/hotels-in-*`), `/search/` with `location`, `city`, `searchType`, `country`, `filters`; content/legal `/about`, `/faq`, `/privacy-policy`, `/terms`, `/guest-policy`, `/referral`, `/mobileapps`; `/login?country=&retUrl=/`; `/business/login`; `/superAgent/landing`; legacy `/blog/*` WordPress paths. UI exposes OTP-phone textbox and `Verify Number`; no OTP attempt.
- `bff.oyorooms.com`: JSON API host; observed GET templates: `/v1/hotels/{hotel_id}`, `/v1/amenities/{hotel_id}`, `/v1/hotels/reviews`, `/v1/hotels/coupons/details`, `/hotel/images`, `/v2/searchHotels`, `/v1/getPayNowHotelData`, plus JavaScript-disclosed `/v1/createBooking`, `/v1/saveUserEnquiryDetails`, `/v1/updateHotelInformation`. Primary query keys: hotel_id, selected_rcid, available_room_count[checkin|checkout], checkin, checkout, amount, channel, rooms_config, user_mode, country_id, rcid, property_type, currency_code, offset, limit, filters, search_type, fields, additional_fields. Unauthenticated observed responses were 400/401; no request mutation.
- `frames.oyorooms.com`: public photography-partner site (React, Bootstrap). UI routes/contact links `/contact`, `/faqs`, plus login control. JS disclosed routes include `/apigateway`, `/ssoLogin`, `/ForgotPassword`, `/ResetPassword`, `/users/password_reset`, `/jobs/search`, and vendor/job/photo route families. Crawl GETs returned 404 for many and `/apigateway` 500; no auth interaction.
- `business.oyorooms.com`: OYO B marketing/corporate booking site; `/` resolved to `/business/`; static JS/CSS retrieval returned 503 during crawl, and browser session navigated to blank document after initial render.
- `partners.oyorooms.com`: Landingi/JQuery property-listing marketing page; Start Listing buttons, `/account/` discovered.
- `partner.oyorooms.com`: HTTP/HTTPS root 302 to `https://patron.oyorooms.com/` (covered by separate exact-host mapper).
- `web.oyorooms.com`: Landingi/JQuery housekeeping checklist form. Form POST action is `/submit/{opaque-id}`; non-submitted field names include `email`, `name`, `number`, `date`, `radio` through `radio50` plus hidden metadata fields. No form submission.

No GraphQL or OpenAPI/Swagger evidence in captured routes/bundles. Raw artifacts are in `/workspace/oyorooms-com-recon/`.

57508f.title: Innov8.work surface discovery map
57508f.content:
## Coverage and reachability
- `https://www.innov8.work/` is the canonical public React/webpack app: `200`. HTTP redirects (`301`) to HTTPS. Tech evidence: Akamai (`Server: AkamaiGHost` for HTTP redirect), HSTS, Google Tag Manager/Analytics, ShareThis, React/webpack, and Sentry endpoint in public bundle.
- Apex `http(s)://innov8.work/` returned `403 text/plain` (26 bytes) through the scope proxy; no redirect observed.
- Discovered in-scope `https://investor-relations.innov8.work/investor-relations` is an investor document landing page. Its root `/` and `/account/` are `404`; crawler observed only its landing page, `assets/js/landend/frodo.js`, and 404 assets. Its `/robots.txt` and `/sitemap.xml` both returned `403`.
- `www` `robots.txt` disallows `/admin/`, `/download/`, `/bitnami/*`, and `/?s=*`; `sitemap.xml` returned 258 URLs. `sitemap_index.xml` redirects to `/sitemap/`, which serves the SPA HTML.

## Public routes
- Bundle route templates: `/`, `/about-us`, `/contact-us`, `/referral`, `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/vyapaar`, `/search`, `/profile/:tab?`, `/booking-details/:buildingId/:catalogId`, `/payment-success/:orderId`, `/payment-failure/:orderId`.
- Search/listing templates: `/coworking-space/:parameter`, `/coworking-space/:parameter/:buildingId`, `/office-space`, `/office-space/:parameter`, `/office-space/:parameter/:buildingId`, `/meeting-rooms/:city/:locality`.
- Sitemap family counts: 96 coworking-space, 82 blog, 40 office-space, 34 meeting-rooms plus static content routes; it also includes city/locality and specific building-slug routes. Raw sitemap URL list: `/workspace/innov8-recon/sitemap-urls.txt`.
- Investor page links externally to Google Drive annual reports/AGM notices (not followed because out of scope).

## Forms and UI
- Header Login opens an email-only form. Browser session remained anonymous: `GET /api/auth/session` -> `200 {"is_authenticated":false,"message":"No session cookie found"}`; no sign-up/register UI observed.
- Contact callback form fields: `name`, `email`, `phone`, area-of-interest select, location select, `companyName`. Bundle maps submission to `POST /api/leadSubmit` payload `{city, companyName, customerName, email, mobileNo, productType, meta}`. Not submitted.
- Referral is a two-step form: client fields `clientName`, `clientEmail`, `clientNumber`; referral fields `referralName`, `referralEmail`, `referralNumber`; required terms checkbox. Bundle constructs a lead payload `{city, buildingId, customerName, email, mobileNo, meta:{refName, refEmail, refMobile}}`; not submitted.

## API / service inventory (bundle- or browser-observed; not tested)
- Browser-confirmed: `GET /api/auth/session` (anonymous response above), `POST /api/listFilteredCities` (empty JSON body, `200`, city/product catalogue returned).
- Public bundles disclose: `/api/pageError`, `/api/listFilteredCities`, `/api/listBuildings`, `/api/leadSubmit`, `/api/filteredAllProductsBuildings`, `/api/buildingData`, `/api/validate`, `/api/coupon`, `/api/cityContentSeo`, `/api/cms/:cmsId?transformationRequired=true&templateName=...`, `/api/user`, `/api/user/business-details`, `/api/auth/generate-otp`, `/api/auth/verify-otp`, `/api/auth/session`, `/api/user/profile`, `/api/auth/logout`.
- Public bundle also discloses transactional order route templates (not invoked): `/order/availability`, `/order/initPayment`, `/order/verifyAndBook`, `/order/verifyPayment`, `/order/invoice`.
- CMS template names exposed: Innov8HomePage, Innov8ListingTemplate, coWorkingCenterPageTemplate, Innov8HeaderTemplate, Innov8FooterTemplate, Innov8ParentTemplate, Innov8OfferingPageTemplate, Innov8OfferingDetailsTemplate, Innov8ContactUs, Innov8PrivacyPolicy, Innov8TermsAndConditions, Innov8Referral, Innov8ReferralNew, Innov8AboutUs.

## Evidence/gaps
- Raw artifacts are under `/workspace/innov8-recon/` (crawler output, robots/sitemap bodies, browser network, asset bundles, SPA pattern list). No GraphQL or OpenAPI/Swagger evidence appeared.
- Broad wildcard limitation: only `www.innov8.work` and `investor-relations.innov8.work` were linked/discovered through allowed proxy-routed discovery; no independent DNS/CT enumeration was performed. Third-party asset/analytics hosts shown in page traffic were not followed as they are out of scope.
- The initial `www` Katana run was stopped after about 83 seconds when it had reached 40,586 raw URL records caused largely by generated/malformed and duplicate URLs; sitemap and normalized route/bundle evidence provide the retained bounded map.
